answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns twice its 30-day earnings and locks it for 20 epochs. Honest agents pay once and earn it back from real work, like a grower tending one orchard, not a thousand empty rows. Each slot is a trellis for one agent alone. The agent must thread its own proof through it before each payout. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 deposits, far above any diluted reward.
